title: Sovel · App icon concepts v1
status: Option B selected by the user; integrated into iOS, Android and web icon resources.

variants.name: 金环唱片
variants.concept: A minimal analog record emblem. One strong circular vinyl silhouette with a luminous champagne-gold outer annular band, two widely spaced delicate concentric grooves inside, and a tiny circular spindle hole. A short integrated elegant tonearm accent at the upper right makes the symbol unmistakably a record, simplified into a geometric stroke rather than a mechanical illustration. Black center. Warm satin metal edge lit softly from upper left. The circular annulus is bold enough for small sizes, grooves only secondary. Precise, quiet, tactile. No lettering.
variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: app icon concept for Sovel, a refined cross-platform local HiFi music player for Android music players and iOS. Produce ONE square 1024x1024 icon master, a single symbol, centered front view. Entire canvas is the icon, full bleed near-black charcoal #151617 background, without an outer border, without an app tile floating on a larger background, without rounded external corners (the OS mask will be applied separately). Dominant mark must occupy about 60% of the width, remain clear at 48px, ample consistent negative space. Restrained champagne gold #D5B782 with warm light highlights, premium understated contemporary music hardware sensibility, subtle depth and satin light but clean graphic edges. No words, no Sovel wordmark, no letters except when requested below, no watermark, no device mockup, no UI, no comparison grid. Never resemble Apple Music, Spotify, Beats, or a known brand logo.

variants.name: 声律
variants.concept: A bold original soundwave emblem built from exactly five separate vertical rounded capsules. Vary the heights into a graceful asymmetric rising and falling rhythm, with a tall center column and shorter outer columns; retain generous black gaps. Each capsule is a restrained champagne-gold satin bar with a slight sculptural highlight, not neon. Compact flowing waveform silhouette, no enclosing circle. Very clear at tiny sizes, modern and disciplined, evocative of a premium amplifier's level meter. No letters or music note.

variants.name: 流动 S
variants.concept: An original custom capital S monogram, formed from one broad flowing champagne-gold ribbon bending into a compact elegant S. The ribbon uses carefully designed negative space, with a gentle satin highlight suggesting a sound signal in motion, no rainbow and no chrome extrusion. The two terminals are softly rounded and slightly diagonal, shapes thick and simple enough for a 48px icon. Geometric, balanced, recognizable, modern music identity. The S is the only letter; no other lettering, no currency sign, no circle.

variants.name: 声场
variants.concept: An abstract sonic aperture, an original sculptural sound-field emblem made of three broad nested open arcs, as if a soft golden wave expands outward from an intimate dark listening space. The arc openings are aligned on a gentle diagonal, and the arcs interlock visually into a compact rounded triangular swirl with a central dark aperture. A single coherent warm-gold mark, carefully balanced gaps, slightly dimensional satin light, polished minimalism. An expressive atmospheric alternative to a literal vinyl record. No central dot, no music note, no letters, no WiFi icon, no sun rays.
